newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends firmer but off highs.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends firmer but off highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled firmer and over key 10.54 cents in March, lifted by steady short-covering by the funds, market sources said.
"The funds covered about half their shorts and the market closed at its highest level in more than two weeks," a broker said.
The March contract settled at 10.62 January 15.
Steady producer selling at each point up knocked prices off the highs, but follow-through short-covering is expected Thursday.
Resistance basis March is now seen at 10.70 cents, the high made January 16.
A broker noted light selling in the March/May spread, adding that "the longs are in the driver's seat. The spreads have done nothing but strengthen over the last week."
The March/May spread closed at 0.06 compared with 0.05 on Tuesday.
March settled 0.14 cent higher at 10.58 cents a lb, having ranged from 10.62 to 10.49 cents a lb. The deferred contracts ended 0.13 to 0.01 firmer.
Volume was estimated at a brisk 23,7681 lots.
